                                                                 PROPER NOUN 
 স থদা Capital letter  হব্দ ।

            e.g. Bangladesh, Karim, Rabindranath, Dhaka, The Padma, Rome, Africa, New Year etc.   
 সাধারণত Proper Noun এর পূব্দ থ the  ব্দস না। 
 
Exception: নদী, সাগর, উপসাগর, মহাসাগর, সং াদপত্র, জাহাজ, এব্দরাব্দেন, যেন, ক খ্যাত অট্টাকে া, প থতমাো, দ্বীপপুঞ্জ, মরুভূকম, ধমথগ্রন্থ,

                                                                 COMMON NOUN 
 যে স ে Noun দ্বারা কনকদষ্ট য াব্দনা ব্যকি,  স্তু, স্থাব্দনর নাম না বুকঝব্দয় এ জতীয় স েব্দ ই য াঝায় তাব্দদরব্দ  Common Noun

 স ে Noun দ্বারা সমজাতীয় ক ছু ব্যকি,  স্তুর সমকষ্টব্দ  য াঝায় তাব্দদরব্দ  Collective Noun  ব্দে। 
 ক ছু Common Noun এর সমকষ্ট াচ  নামব্দ  Collective Noun  ব্দে।

 Collective noun এর সদস্যব্দদর মব্দে ক িাজন সৃকষ্ট হব্দে তাব্দদরব্দ  এ ব্দত্র না বুকঝব্দয় প্রব্দতয ব্দ  আোদািাব্দ   া স্বতন্ত্রিাব্দ  বুঝায় 
এ ং এই ক িাকজত সমকষ্ট Noun of multitude  ব্দে। 
 যেব্দহতু ক িাকজত সমকষ্টব্দ  য াঝায়,মাব্দন এব্দ র অকধ  তাই Noun of multitude এর verb এ ং pronoun 
দ্যব্দ াই plural হব্দয় র্াব্দ ।

      [verb plural হব্দয়ব্দে  ারন এখাব্দন divided অর্থাৎ সদস্যব্দদর মব্দে ক িাজন সৃকষ্ট হব্দয়ব্দে ]

                                                           MATERIAL NOUN 
 যে স ে Noun দ্বারা য াব্দনা পদাব্দর্থর পৃকর্ ীব্দত ক দ্যমান সম্পূণ থ অকিত্বব্দ  অক িাজযিাব্দ  য াঝায় এ ং োব্দদরব্দ  সংখ্যা দ্বারা গণনা 
 রা োয় না ক ন্তু এ   দ্বারা পকরমাপ  রা োয়, তাব্দদরব্দ  Material Noun  ব্দে। 
           যেমন: Diamond, Gold, Iron, Water, Oil, Rice, Paper, Milk, Salt, Brick ইতযাকদ আ ার, 
 খাদ্য য াঝাব্দে Material Noun হয়। 
Ex: Fish is good for food.   Mango is my favorite food.  Here “Mango & Fish” is a material noun. 
 (Material Noun এর অপর নাম Mass noun.

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                           Pronoun-Page | 1 
                                                             
                                                                 PRONOUN 
 
Noun এর পররবর্তে pronoun বর্ে। এ কারর্ে pronoun কক substituting word (রবকল্প বা বদরি বা প্ররতস্থারপত শব্দ) বর্ি। 
1. A word that takes the place of a noun is called-   [সুপারিনটেনটেন্ট ১৯.০৮.২০১৯] 
       a) a subject                  b) an adverb            c) a pronoun                d) an object  ⓒ 
2. No article is used before - [বাাংিার্দশ পল্লী রবদ্যুতায়ন কবার্ে; ১৫/০৭/২০২৩, বাাংিার্দশ পল্লী রবদ্যুতায়ন কবার্ে; েহকারী পররচািক: ০৯/০৬/২০২৩] 
 a) an adjective  b) a pronoun  c) an adverb   d) a noun  ⓑ 
3. A pronoun takes the place of a/an-  [রব আর রে রেরনয়র অরিোর- ৯৮]    
       a) antecedent        b) verb            c) a subject                d) noun   ⓓ 
4. A substituting word is called a -   [RU (েমাজরবজ্ঞান) 09-10]         
       a) noun             b) adverb             c) pronoun            d) verb   ⓒ 
5. Among the students, the best one is a boy.' Here 'one' is used as – [CU (b) 02-03] 
       a) noun             b) adverb             c) pronoun            d) verb   ⓒ 
 
                                         EIGHT TYPES OF PRONOUNS 
1. Personal pronoun 
(including possessive adj.) 
me, my, mine, we, us, our, ours, you, thee, your, yours, he, him, his, she, 
her, hers, it, its, they, them, their, theirs 
2. Reflexive pronoun & 
Emphatic pronoun 
myself, ourselves, yourself, yourselves, himself, herself, themselves etc. 
(noun/pronoun এর পর্র বের্িই এরা Emphatic pronoun) 
3. Demonstrative pronoun this, these, that, those, so, such, the same, one, ones etc. 
4. Indefinite pronoun one, any, some, many, all, few, several, none, no one, everyone, someone, 
nobody, anybody, somebody, anything, nothing, everything, they, another, 
other (s) 
5. Interrogative pronoun what, which, who, whom, whose etc. 
6. Relative pronoun what, which, who, whom, whose, that, as, but, whoever, whatever, 
whichever etc. 
7.Distributive pronoun each, either, neither etc. 
8. Reciprocal pronoun each other, one another etc.

                                                            RELATIVE PRONOUN 
Relative pronoun যে সকল pronoun দুটি sentence এর মধ্যে সম্পকক স্থাপন কধ্যর। যেমন: who, whom, whose, which, what, 
that ইত্যাদি।  
Subject Form -- Who, Whoever Object Form -- Whom, Whomever  
Adjective Form -- Whose বস্তুবাচক হধ্যল -- Which, that  
 
Relative Pronoun এর ববদিষ্ট্য বা যচনার উপায়। 
• Relative Pronoun বাধ্যকযর মাধ্যে বধ্যস। 
• সাধারণত্ বাধ্যকযর যিধ্যে full stop হয়। 
• দুধ্য া clause যক যুক্ত কধ্যর দবধায় সব কিা Complex Sentence 
গঠন কধ্যর 
• ত্ধ্যব বাধ্যকযর শুরুধ্যত্ Auxiliary verb থাকধ্যল 
• ইহার Antecedent (পূব কপি) থাধ্যক দকন্তু প্রথধ্যম বসধ্যল ইহার

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                     Adjective: Page | 1 
 
 
                                                                                   ADJECTIVE  
Adjective সর্বদাই noun/pronoun কে qualify/modify েরে অর্বাৎ noun/pronoun এে কদাষ, গুণ, অর্স্থা, সংখ্যা পরেমাণ প্রোশ 
েরে র্রে এরে qualifying/modifying word র্া qualifier র্রে। Adjective প্রধানত দুই প্রোে, attributive adjective এর্ং 
predicative adjective. 
 
Attributive adjective: Adjective যখন Noun এে পূরর্ব র্রস তাে attribute র্া কদাষগুণ প্রোশ েরে তখন তারে Attribute 
adjective র্রে। কযমন: He is an intelligent boy. 
 
Predicate Adjective: Adjective যখন verb এে পরে Predicate রিরসরর্ র্রস Noun র্া Pronoun এো কদাষগুণ প্রোশ েরে 
তখন তারে Predicative Adjective র্রে। কযমন: He is intelligent. 
NOTE: েতগুরো adjective কযমন: alike, afraid, alive, aloof, asleep, ashamed, alone, awake, aware, content 
ইতযারদ সাধােণত শুধুমাত্র predicative adjective রিরসরর্ ব্যর্হৃত িয়। I like being alone at home. 
1. A/an ---- is used to qualify or limit the meaning of something.  
      a) noun   b) verb   c) adjective    d) adverb  ⓒ 
2. An adjective modifies---- 
      a) noun & pronoun b) adverb  c) verb    d) preposition  ⓐ 
3. An adjective is a----. 
      a) naming word  b) modifying word     c) qualifying word  
      d) substituting word        e) b & c  ⓔ 
4. The two types of adjectives are: 
      a) attributive and relative    b) predicative and collective 
      c) attributive and predicative   d) predicative and alternative    ⓒ 
 
 
 
                                EIGHT KINDS OF ADJECTIVES IN TERMS OF NATURE 
Kinds of Adjectives How to recognize them Examples 
(1) Proper Adjectives Proper Noun কর্রে Proper 
Adjective িয়। 
Asian, Chinese, French. English. 
African. Panjabi, etc. 
(2) Adjective of quality Noun র্া Pronoun-এে কদাষ, গুণ র্া 
অর্স্থা প্রোশ েরে। 
good, bad, wise, noble, rich, 
poor, great, hot, cold, warm, etc. 
(3) Adjective of quantity Noun র্া Pronoun-এে Quantity র্া 
পরেমাণ বুঝায়। 
much, huge, some, a little, all, 
any. half, full, whole, enough etc. 
(4) Numeral Adjective Noun র্া pronoun-এে সংখ্যা বুঝায়। one, two, three, four, first, 
second, third, fourth, all, any, 
many, some, several, each, every, 
a few etc. 
(5) Demonstrative Adjective কোন ব্যরি র্া র্স্তুরে রর্রশষভারর্ রনরদবশ 
েরে। 
this, that, these, those, the same, 
such, etc. 
(6) Distributive Adjective এোরধে ব্যরি র্া র্স্তুে মরে প্ররতযেরে 
পৃর্েভারর্ রনরদবশ েরে। 
each, every, either. neither. 
(7) Interrogative Adjective Interrogative Pronoun (WH 
words) যখন Noun এে পূরর্ব র্রস 
adjective এে মত োজ েরে। 
what, which, whose 
(8) Possessive Adjective Noun এে পূরর্ব র্রস adjective এে মত 
োজ েরে। 
my, his, her, your, their, its 
 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                     Adjective: Page | 2 
 
 
                                                                        NUMERAL ADJECTIVE 
Numeral Adjective-দুই প্রোে, যর্া: 
 Definite Numeral Adjective: noun এে রনরদবষ্ট সংখ্যা র্া পযবায় র্া গুরণতে বুঝায়। ইিা রতন প্রোে, যর্া: 
i) Cardinal Numeral: One, two, three, four, five ইতযারদ 
ii) Ordinal Numeral: First, second, third, fourth, fifth ইতযারদ 
iii) Multiplicative Numeral: Single, double, triple, quadruple, fivefold ইতযারদ 
 
 Indefinite Numeral Adjective: noun এে অরনরদবষ্ট সংখ্যা বুঝায়। 
            Ex: All men must die, এেইভারর্, some, several, many, few, no ইতযারদ 
 
                                                                       PRONOMINAL ADJECTIVE 
Pronoun যখন কোরনা Noun এে পূরর্ব র্রস Adjective এে মত োজ েরে। 
Note. এখন modern grammar & Pronominal adjective গুরোরে determiner র্ো িয়। 
  
                                                                         RELATIVE ADJECTIVE 
What, which, whose যখন যারোে মের্তী ক ারনা noun এে পূরর্ব র্াস Adjective এে মত োজ েরে।  
Ex: Atia asked me which shirt I liked.               Do you know whose phone it is? 
                                                            
                                                                    EMPHASIZING ADJECTIVE 
Own এর্ং very শব্দ দুটি কজােসূচে (Emphasizing) adjective রূরপ ব্যর্হৃত িয়।  
Ex: He is my own brother. (কস আমাে আপন ভাই).     I want this very thing. (এই রজরনসটাই আমাে চাই) 
5. 'I like Japanese cars'-Which form of adjective is the underlined word?

      a) quality   b) quantity  c) numeral    d) none  ⓒ

      c) Pronominal adjective    d) Descriptive adjective    ⓒ

      a) these   b) those   c) this   d) that    ⓑ

      a) Proper   b) Numeral  c) Distributive   d) Demonstrative ⓓ

      a) Proper   b) Numeral  c) Distributive   d) Demonstrative ⓓ 
14. Every man is potential. Here 'every' is - 
      a) noun   b) adjective  c) pronoun   d) adverb  ⓑ 
15. "I shall support neither party"  
      a) Proper  b) Numeral   c) Distributive   d) Demonstrative ⓒ 
16. Which colour do you like best? Here the word 'Which' is a/an- 
      a) Interrogative pronoun    b) Demonstrative pronoun    ⓐ 
      c) Relative pronoun     d) Interrogative adjective 
17. Choose the sentence which shows possessive adjective: 
      a) This is his car.     b) That book is mine     ⓐ 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                     Adjective: Page | 3 
 
      c) It's a business of their's.   d) This house is belongs to them  
 
  
                                                                        MOST IMPORTANT RULES 
 Adjective এে সারর্ েখরনা s/es যুি িয় না।

                                                                       DEGREE 
সাধারণত adjective থেকে দুইকের মকে তুলনা এবং দুইকের অধধকের মকে তুলনা থবাঝাকত adjective এর থে রূপ ব্যবহৃত হে, তাকে 
Degree of Comparison বকল। এইভাকব, adjective এর ধতনটি রূপ বা form হকলা- 
         Positive Degree 
 
1. adjective েখন সাধারণভাকব বকস। 
 
2. so/as + adjective + as 
 
Example: 
Rahim is as tall as Karim. 
Rahim is not so tall as Karim. 
       Comparative Degree 
 
1. েখন দুটি ব্যধি বা বস্তুর মকে তুলনা েরা 
হে। 
2. Comparative form of Adj. + 
than. 
Example: 
Rahim is taller than Karim. 
 
       Superlative Degree 
 
1. েখন দুইকের অধধে ব্যধি বা বস্তুর মকে 
তুলনা েরা হে। 
2. the + superlative form of Adj. 
  
Example: 
Rahim is tallest boy in the class. 
Rahim is one of the tallest boys 
in the class. 
 
1. সাধারণত এে syllable ধবধিষ্ট adjective থেকে comparative form এ er এবং superlative form এ est থোগ হে।  
থেমন: tall-taller-tallest,         long-longer-longest,              short-shorter-shortest 
 
2. Positive degree এর থিকে e োেকল শুধু r এবং st থোগ হে। থেমন: wise-wiser-wisest 
 
3. positive এর থিকে y োেকল এবং তার পূকব ে consonant োেকল y থে i েকর comparative এ er এবং Superlative এ est থোগ 
হে। তকব y এর পূকব ে vowel োেকল থোন পধরবতেন না হকে েোক্রকম থে এবং est. থোগ হে। 
 
4. দুই বা তকতাধধে syllable ধবধিষ্ট adjective এর comparative at superlative েরকত হকল more এবং most অেবা less এবং 
least থোগ েরকত হে। থেমন। more/less active, most/least active  
 
*েতগুকলা adjective আকে োকের ধনেমানুসাকর comparative ও superlative হে না। 
                       Positive                   Comparative                    Superlative   
                     Good, well                        better                         best 
                    Bad, evil, ill                        worse                        Worst  
                          little                             less                        least 
                     Much, many                         more                                                   most 
                         Fore                         former                   Foremost, first 
                        Hind                          hinder                       Hindermost 
                        Late                           Latter                          Last  
                        old                       Older, elder                     Oldest, eldest  
                        Near                          Nearer                     Nearest, next  
                        Far                           farther                        farthest 
 
*েতগুকলা word এর positive degree হে না ধেন্তু comparative superlative রূকপ ব্যবহৃত হে। 
                       Positive                   Comparative                    Superlative   
                       in                           inner             inmost, innermost 
                       up                      upper             uppermost, upmost 
                      out                   outer, utter             outmost, outermost, 
             utmost, uttermost.

       a) More up  b) Most up  c) uppermost  d) upper   ⓒ

একের superlative েরকত হকল একের পকর most থোগ েরকত হে। থেমন: top- topmost, head-headmost ইতযাধে।

Positive Very few + S2, (plural) + V (plural)+ as/so + positive + as + S1 
(Very few boys in the class are as good as he.)

                                                                       ADVERB 
 An adverb is a word used to qualify any parts of speech (except a noun or pronoun) or a whole 
sentence. 
 Adverb হল ো এমন word যো বোলযে ব্যবহৃত noun or pronoun ব্যততত প্রলতেযটি parts of speech কয অথবো ক োটো বোযেলয 
modify বো তবলেতিত যরলত পোলর। ----P.C. Das 
 
***তলব- adverb এর মু  যোজ হলে verb, adjective, adverb কয modify যরো। অন্য গুল োলয (preposition, conjunction, 
and sentence) মু  যোজ তহলেলব ধরো হয় নো। 
 
 Emon runs quickly. (quickly, modifies runs, a verb) 
                       Verb        adverb 
 she is a very beautiful girl. (very, modifies beautiful, an adjective.) 
                 Adv.          Adj. 
 She sings extremely well (extremely, modifies well, an Adverb.) 
                    Adv.          Adv. 
 The bird flew exactly over our head. (exactly, modifies over, a preposition) 
                         Adv.     preposition 
 I dislike him simply because he is a liar, (simply, modifies because, a conjunction) 
                        Adv.     conjunction 
 Unfortunately, he could not continue his studies. (unfortunately, modifies a whole sentence) 
        Adv.                                               whole sentence                     
***** Where, when, how, why এেব দ্বোরো প্রশ্ন যরল  কয উত্তর পোওয়ো যোয়, তোই adverb.                     
 
  
                                                      CLASSIFICATION OF ADVERB 
Adverb of time  
(When?) 
Now, then, before, since, ago, already, today, tonight, yesterday, tomorrow, 
still, yet, lately, immediately, late.  
Adverb of place 
(Where?) 
abroad, home, here, there, away, upstairs, downstairs, everywhere, nowhere, 
somewhere, above, below, in, inside, out, outside, back  
Adverb of manner 
(How?) 
badly, well, aloud, silently, sadly, softly, slowly, swiftly, simply, ill, fast, hard, 
barely, wisely, quickly, highly, together, alone. 
Adverb of frequency 
(How often?, যত বোর?) 
always, often, seldom, usually, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never, ever, 
regularly, once, twice, thrice, again, weekly 
Adverb of degree almost, much, nearly, quite, too, very, little, more, enough, slightly, somewhat, 
rather, partly 
Adverb of purpose so, so that, in order to, since, intentionally 
Adverb of order First, second, secondly, third, last, lastly, etc.

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                   Verb, Page | 1 
 
                                                                          
                                                         VERB 
 A verb is a word used to say something about some person, place or thing. – J.C Nesfield. 
 A Verb is a word that tells or asserts something about a person or thing. -Wren & Martin. 
 যে word য োন ব্যক্তি, বস্তু বো স্থোন সম্পর্ ে বলোর জন্য ব্যবহৃত হয় তোর্  verb বর্ল। 
 The essential part of a sentence is verb. So, every English sentence must have a verb. 
 
1. If you want to write a sentence, you must need----.       ⓑ 
      a) subject      b)verb            c) object  d) complement  
2. Verb agrees with--- 
      a) noun      b) pronoun   
      c) adjective     d) subject, number and person   ⓓ 
3. Which one of the following is correct?  [রোজশোহী কৃক্তি উন্নয়ন ব্যোাং  – ১১] 
      a) Every English sentence must have a verb. b) Every English sentence should have a verb. 
      c) Every English sentence has a verb.  d) Every sentence has a verb.    ⓐ 
                                                                            
  
            
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
                                                                
                                                              FINITE VERB 
যে Verb Sentence এর বিব্য সমোপ্ত  রর্ত পোর্র এবাং verb এর রূপ, tense, person ও number অনুেোয়ী পক্তরবতেন হয়, তোর্  
finite verb বর্ল। Ex: He wants to play Cricket. 
                                                               
                                                              NON-FINITE VERB 
যে verb Sentence এর বিব্য সমোপ্ত  রর্ত পোর্র নো এবাং verb এর রূপ, tense, person ও number অনুেোয়ী পক্তরবতেন হয় নো তোর্  
Non-finite verb বর্ল।   Ex: Swimming in the ocean is my favorite summer activity. 
 
                                                               PRINCIPAL VERB 
যে verb অন্য য োন verb এর সোহোয্য ব্যক্ততত স্বোধীনভোর্ব বোর্ ের অর্ে সম্পন্ন  রর্ত পোর্র, তোর্  Principal verb বো main verb বর্ল। 
 য োন বোর্ ে এ টিমোত্র Verb র্ো র্ল তো অবশ্যই main verb/ principal verb হয়।

                                                  INDIRECT OBJECT & DIRECT OBJECT 
 
 Direct Object — verb য  ‘ক্ত  (what)’ প্রশ্ন  রর্ল উত্তর' েো আর্স, যসটি direct object হয়। 
              Ex: 1. He writes a letter. 
                      ➡ প্রশ্ন: He writes what? → a letter, তোই a letter হর্লো Direct Object। 
                       2. We watched a movie. 
                      ➡ প্রশ্ন: We watched what? → a movie, তোই a movie হর্লো Direct Object। 
 
 Indirect Object — verb য  ‘ োর জন্য/ োর্  (to/for whom)’ প্রশ্ন  রর্ল যেটো আর্স, যসটি indirect object হয়। 
             Ex: 1. She gave me a book. 
                       ➡ প্রশ্ন: She gave whom a book? → me, তোই me হর্লো Indirect Object। 
                   2. They sent her a letter. 
                     ➡ প্রশ্ন: They sent whom a letter? → her, তোই her হর্লো Indirect Object। 
 
 Direct object — বোর্ ে verb এর এ টিমোত্র object (ব্যক্তি/বস্তু) র্ো র্ল তো direct object হয়। 
Ex: 1. He reads a book  
            ➡ প্রশ্ন: He reads what? → a book ,তোই a book হর্লো Direct Object। 
                    2. They called me. 
                     ➡ প্রশ্ন: They called whom? → me, তোই me হর্লো Direct Object।

                    বোর্ ে verb এর দুর্টো object র্ো র্ল Direct ও Indirect Object যচনোর য ৌশল: 
Step 1: Verb-এর পর্র দুটি object র্ো র্ল — প্রর্মটো সোধোরণত Indirect Object, পর্ররটো Direct Object হয়। 
Step 2: 
 "What?" ক্তদর্য় প্রশ্ন  রর্ল → Direct Object 
 "To whom?" বো "For whom?" ক্তদর্য় প্রশ্ন  রর্ল → Indirect Object 
Example 1: He gave his friend a gift. 
                 ➡ Gave what? → a gift → Direct Object 
                 ➡ Gave to whom? → his friend → Indirect Object 
Example 2: She told me a story. 
                 ➡ Told what? → a story → Direct Object 
                 ➡ Told to whom? → me → Indirect Object

এই "it" য  বলো হয় Impersonal ‘it’, এবাং verb-টি হয় impersonal verb। 
 
 Impersonal verb গুর্লো সোধোরণত weather, time, distance, nature, environment ইতেোক্তদ প্র োশ  র্র। 
      Ex: It rains in the rainy season. 
74. It is snowing heavily. 
a) causative  b) copulative  c) Impersonal  d) factitive   ⓒ 
75. It is getting dark. 
a) linking              b) sub. complement   c) factitive verb  d) Impersonal   ⓓ 
76. It is 8 o'clock. 
a) retained   b) Impersonal  c) reflexive  d) factitive.    ⓑ 
77. It is foggy outside. 
a) causative  b) copulative  c) Impersonal  d) factitive   ⓒ 
78. It thunders loudly during storms. 
a) retained   b) Impersonal  c) reflexive  d) factitive.    ⓑ 
 
                                                                 GROUP VERB 
য োনো verb এর পর্র preposition বর্স transitive verb হর্য় ক্তভন্ন অর্ে প্র োশ  রর্ল তোর্  phrasal verb/ prepositional verb/ 
group verb বর্ল। Group verb এর পর object (noun/pronoun) বসর্ল তো Transitive verb ক্তহর্সর্ব গণ্য হয়। 
79. She takes after her mother. 
      a) verbal idiom   b) phrasal verb  c) regular verb  d) intransitive verb  ⓑ 
80. Jan turned down the chance to work abroad. The underlined part is  [IU (B) 13-14] 
      a) phrasal verb  b) regular verb  c) linking verb  d) irregular verb  ⓐ 
 
                                                                 STATIVE VERB 
 Stative verbs এমন verb েো য োর্নো অবস্থো, অনুভূক্তত, ধোরণো বো মোক্তল োনো যবোেোয়, বোক্তহে ভোর্ব য োর্নো  োজ (action) যবোেোয় নো। 
বর্ল। যেমন: See, hear, feel, smell, taste, love, like, hate, believe, forget, appear, to be, remain, have, own, 
owe, belong, deserve ইতেোক্তদ।  
 সোধোরণত এই verb গুর্লোর continuous tense হয় নো। 
81. Which one is not a stative verb?  [CU (E) 09-10] 
       a) See   b) Taste  c) Feel   d) Hear e) Laugh ⓔ 
 
                                                                 SEMI-MODAL VERB 
 Need, Dare, used to ইতেোক্তদ গুর্লো modal এবাং main verb উভয়রূর্প ব্যবহৃত হর্য় র্োর্  এ  োরর্ণ এর্দরর্  Semi-modal 
verb বলো হয়।   
82. Which of the following are semi-modals?  [IU (B) 18-19] 
      a) Can, could   b) need, dare  c) will, would  d) must, should  ⓑ 
83. Karim need not think of a job. Here 'need' is a - verb.  [সর োক্তর মোেক্তম  ক্তবদ্যোলয় সহ োরী ক্তশক্ষ  ক্তনর্য়োগ পরীক্ষো-2001] 
      a) Modal   b) Principal  c) Finite  d) none   ⓐ 
84. Which of the following can be used both as a modal and a main verb? [RU 08-09] 
      a) Should    b) Would  c) May   d) Dare   ⓓ 
 
 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                   Verb, Page | 8 
 
                                                                 CAUSATIVE VERB 
 যে স ল verb দ্বোরো subject সরোসক্তর ক্তনর্জ  োজ নো  র্র অন্যর্  ক্তদর্য়  োজটি  রোয় তোর্দরর্  Causative verb বর্ল।  
      Ex: My mother feeds me.  
 intransitive verb েখন causative verb রূর্প ব্যবহৃত হয় তখন তো transitive verb হর্য় েোয়। 
      Ex:The horse walks. = He walks the horse. 
 
        Common verb         Causative verb        Common verb        Causative verb 
Eat Feed Know Inform 
Dive Dip See Show 
Learn Teach Remember Remind 
Fall Fell Rise Raise (উঠোর্নো) 
Lie (শুর্য় র্ো ো, পড়ো) Lay (শুর্য় র্ো ো) Sit Set (স্থোপন  রো/বসোর্নো) 
যে স ল verb এর causative form যনই তোর্দর পূর্বে have, get, make, let, help ইতেোক্তদ বক্তসর্য় Causative verb এর অর্ে প্র োশ 
 রো হয়।  
85. Dip, Feed, Fell, Raise, Set all these words are: [JU 06-07] 
      a) Transitive verb       b) Intransitive verb c) Causative verb d) Factitive verb  ⓒ 
86. He raised his hand. Here 'raised is a ---- verb.   [৭ম ক্তশক্ষ  ক্তনবন্ধন পরীক্ষো (স্কুল পেেোয়) (02-12-2011)] 
      a) copulative  b) cognate  c) factitive  d) causative   ⓓ 
87. "My mother makes me take the medicine.'   [RU 09-10] 
      a) Auxiliary  b) Week  c) Strong  d) Causative   ⓓ 
 
                                                                REFLEXIVE VERB  
Reflexive verb হর্লো এমন এ টি verb েো ক্তনর্জর ওপরই ক্তক্রয়োর প্রভোব যফর্ল। অর্েোৎ, subject ও object এ ই ব্যক্তি হয় এবাং 
reflexive pronoun (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves) ব্যবহোর হয়। 
Ex: 
He hurt himself.  She taught herself French.  I introduced myself to the class. 
88. Which of the following is a reflexive verb? 
a) She sleeps early.    b) He drives a car. 
c) I introduced myself.    d) We cleaned the room.    ⓒ 
89. Identify the reflexive verb in the sentence: “They blamed themselves for the mistake.” 
a) blamed   b) they   c) mistake  d) for    ⓐ 
90. Which of the following does not contain a reflexive verb? 
a) He congratulated himself.   b) She looked at herself. 
c) I taught myself.     d) We ran quickly.     ⓓ 
91. Which sentence uses the reflexive verb correctly? 
a) The cat cleaned herself.   b) The boy kicked the ball. 
c) They talked to each other.   d) I myself did the work.    ⓐ 
92. “She blamed __ for the accident.” Choose the correct option. 
a) her   b) hers   c) herself  d) she    ⓒ 
 
                                                                 PRACTICE MCQ 
93. Which one is an example of an intransitive verb?  [KU (B) 19-20] 
      a) The painted their fences green.        b) My family moved to another city. 
      c) We believed the boy.         d) He gave the papers to the lawyer.   ⓑ 
94. My younger brother has become a lawyer. The underlined word is a. [IU (H) 17-18] 
      a) linking verb  b) transitive verb c) causative verb  d) non-finite verb  ⓐ

      a) inchoative verb      b) verbs of perception   
      c) cognate verb     d) reflexive verb     ⓒ

a) Transitive verb  b) Intransitive verb c) Modal verb  d) Auxiliary verb  ⓑ

97. Which one is transitive verb? [BRUR (A) 12-13] 
      a) The baby sleeps     b) Fire burns 
      c) To err is human     d) The girl takes after her mother   ⓓ 
98. 'She milks the cow.' The intransitive use of this sentence- [IU (H) 17-18] 
      a) The cow milking her.    b) The cow is milked her. 
      c) The cow is milking.    d) The cow is being milked her.   ⓒ 
99. He is called a genius. Here the verb is - 
      a) transitive  b) intransitive  c) linking  d) non-finite   ⓒ 
100. Choose the sentence that does NOT have a transitive verb: 
a) He drinks water. b) I wrote a letter. c) They sleep well. d) She reads a book.  ⓒ

  a) Intransitive  b) Transitive  c) Linking verb d) Auxiliary verb  ⓑ

  a) She drinks water.    b) We know the answer. 
  c) The baby sleeps.    d) He painted a picture.    ⓒ

  a) linking                 b) sub. complement    
  c) obj. complement     d) factitive verb      ⓓ

  a) Transitive verb b) factitive verb c) noun  d) linking verb   ⓓ

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Gerunds vs Participles
chapters.summary: Distinguishing verbal nouns (Gerunds) from verbal adjectives (Participles) with bulletproof tests.
chapters.raw_text:
Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 1 
 
 
                                                                   GERUND 
Gerund হচ্ছে verb +ing যা verb এবং noun এর কাজ কচ্ছর। ককন্তু এটি মূলত noun তাই বাচ্ছকে এটি সাধারণ noun এর মত ব্যবহৃত 
হয়। কারণ gerund (জজরাল্ড) সব বদাই noun এর স্থাচ্ছে ব্যবহৃত হয়। তার মাচ্ছে, জযখাচ্ছে জযখাচ্ছে noun বচ্ছস  জসসব জায়গাই verb +ing  
থাকচ্ছল তা সাধারণত Gerund হচ্ছব। 
 
 Subject of a verb. 
     Ex: Reading improves your vocabulary. ➡এখাচ্ছে Reading হচ্ছলা subject কহসাচ্ছব (gerund). 
 
 Object of a verb (Both direct obj. & indirect obj.) 
           Ex: I enjoy dancing. ➡এখাচ্ছে dancing হচ্ছলা verb ‘enjoy’-এর object (gerund). 
 
 Object of a preposition. 
           Ex: They are good at drawing. ➡এখাচ্ছে drawing হচ্ছলা preposition at-এর object (gerund). 
 
 Complement of a verb (Both sub. Complement & obj. complement). 
           Ex: My hobby is painting. ➡এখাচ্ছে painting subject complement (gerund) কহচ্ছসচ্ছব ব্যবহৃত। 
     Ex: I found him sleeping.  ➡এখাচ্ছে sleeping object complement (gerund) কহচ্ছসচ্ছব ব্যবহৃত। 
  
 As a part of compound noun. (a walking stick) 
           Ex: I bought a walking stick. ➡এখাচ্ছে walking এবং stick কমচ্ছল compound noun → walking stick 
 
 Preposition + possessive এর পচ্ছর gerund বচ্ছস।  
           Ex: He insisted on my going there. ➡এখাচ্ছে my going হচ্ছলা possessive pronoun + gerund. 
1. A verb that acts as noun is called:  [সমাজচ্ছসবা অকধদপ্তর | হাউজ জপচ্ছরন্ট কাম টিচার | ৩১.০৮.২০১৮] 
      a) adverb       b) participle   c) gerund  d) noun   ⓒ 
2. Gerund is similar to -  [KU 06-07] 
      a) noun       b) adjective  c) verb   d) adverb   ⓐ 
3. A 'Gerund' does the work of-  [DU (C) 00-01, RU 07-08]  
      a) a verb and a noun    b) a verb and an adverb 
      c) a verb and conjunction    d) a verb and an adjective    ⓐ 
4. Working in the morning is good for health. Here 'working' is a/an-  [১৩ তম কবচ্ছজএস (সহকারী জজ) -19)] 
      a) pronoun   b) adjective   c) gerund   d) present participle  ⓒ 
5. Reading is an excellent habit. Here the underlined word is a  [38th BCS] 
      a) Gerund    b) Participle  c) Verb   d) Verbal noun   ⓐ 
6. Swimming is good exercise.  [সরকাকর মাধ্যকমক কবদ্যালয় সহকারী কিক্ষক কেচ্ছয়াগ পরীক্ষা-2019-(06-09-2019)] 
      Swimming is a good/great form of exercise. Here 'swimming' is a/an- 
      a) adverb   b) noun  c) gerund  d) verb    ⓒ 
7. He found parking is difficult. Here 'parking' used as – [সরকাকর মাধ্যকমক কবদ্যালয় সহকারী কিক্ষক কেচ্ছয়াগ পরীক্ষা-2001] 
      a) Past continuous  b) Gerund   c) Participle   d) Progressive tense  ⓑ 
found এর পচ্ছর that বসচ্ছব। parking হচ্ছে is এর subject তাই parking হচ্ছে gerund (জজরাল্ড) 
8. ----- is considered a serious crime.  [DU (B) 12-13] 
      a) Shoplift    b) Shoplifting   c) Shoplifter   d) To shoplifting   ⓑ 
9. The underlined word in the sentence 'It has stopped raining' is- [সহকারী অোডজুচ্ছেন্ট-২৬.১২.২০১৫] 
      a) gerund    b) participle   c) infinitive   d) present continuous  ⓐ 
10. He started teaching Hamlet. Here 'teaching' is a  [RU 13-14] 
      a) verb   b) noun  c) participle   d) gerund    ⓓ 
11. Do you enjoy teaching? The underlined word is a-  [RU 10-11] 
      a) a noun   b) a participle   c) a gerund  d) an adjective   ⓒ 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 2 
 
12. He avoided making the same mistakes again. The underlined word is a/an- [জেকলকিিচ্ছের অকডচ্ছয়ন্স করসাস ব অকিসার-৬] 
      a) auxiliary verb   b) object  c) participle  d) gerund   ⓓ 
13. I have no objection to walking. The underlined part is an example of-  [KU (B) 19-20] 
      a) an infinitive   b) a gerund   c) a participle   d) a morpheme  ⓑ  
14. There is no credit in earning money illegally. The underlined word is- [KU (B) 14-15] 
      a) present participle  b) gerund  c) verb   d) Present continuous  ⓑ 
15. He is fond of playing cricket. Here 'playing' is a – [BSMRSTU (C) 14-15] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓑ 
16. By working hard, you can prosper. Here 'working’ is a [DU (A) 11-12] 
      a) auxiliary verb  b) object  c) participle   d) gerund   ⓓ 
17. Giving is better than receiving. Here the 'receiving' is a/an- [RU (E) 11-12] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓑ 
18. Walking is good exercise. Here 'walking' is- [শ্রম পকরদপ্তচ্ছর জেসংখ্যা ও পকরবারকল্যাণ কমবকতবা-১০.০৪.২০০৯] 
      a) pronoun   b) adjective   c) gerund   d) present participle  ⓒ 
19. Seeing is believing. Here'believing' is- [সরকাকর মাধ্যকমক কবদ্যালয় সহকারী কিক্ষক কেচ্ছয়াগ পরীক্ষা-2008-(10-10-2008)] 
      a) object of preposition     b) complement of verb  
      c) object of transitive verb   d) object of subject.     ⓑ 
20. My favorite activity is reading. The underlined word is a/an- [IU 10-11, KU 07-08] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓑ 
21. This is a walking stick. The underlined word is a/an- [NSTU (C) 15-16] 
      a) participle  b) gerund  c) verbal noun  d) adverbial   ⓑ 
 Compound noun এ for কদচ্ছয় বাকে গঠে হচ্ছল gerund হচ্ছব। Ex: swimming pool (pool for swimming), more 
Ex: writing table, drinking water, living room, reading room, sleeping room, walking street, walking path, 
working day, working condition, playing ground,, frying pan, hunting whip, helping mind, bleaching 
powder, parking place. 
 
 can't help, can't bear/stand, it's no use/good, worth, এর পচ্ছর verb+ing বসচ্ছল তা gerund হচ্ছব।  
Ex: I cannot help smoking. I cannot bear/stand hearing her cry. It is no good/use arguing. There's nothing 
worth reading in this newspaper. It is no use trying to escape. 
 
 After determiner/adjective: determiner এবং adjective এর পচ্ছর noun এর স্থাচ্ছে verb+ing 
বসচ্ছল তা gerund হচ্ছব। Ex: No smoking. No parking. A little learning, some/a lot of shopping 
 
                                                                 PARTICIPLE 
Participle কাজ কচ্ছর adjective এবং verb এর। ককন্তু প্রাথকমকিাচ্ছব ইহা adjective এবং বাচ্ছকে noun জক qualify কচ্ছর।  
Participle কতে প্রকার। 
 present participle = verb + ing জযাচ্ছগ গঠিত এবং adjective এবং verb এর কাজ কচ্ছর। 
(যকদ verb জথচ্ছক উৎপন্ন হচ্ছয় adjective এর কাজ কচ্ছর তখে present participle জক verbal adjective বলা হয়।) 
 past participle = past form হচ্ছয় adjective এবং verb এর কাজ কচ্ছর। 
 perfect participle = having +V3 (Having finished his homework, he went out to play.) adjective 
এর কাজ কচ্ছর। 
NOTE: 'Participle' verb, adjective ছাড়াও adverb, preposition এবং conjunction কহচ্ছসচ্ছবও কাজ কচ্ছর।  
 
                                                     PRESENT PARTICIPLE 
 Article এবং noun এর মাচ্ছে verb+ing বচ্ছস noun জক modify করচ্ছল present participle হচ্ছব। 
 Intransitive verb (go, come, die, lie, run etc.) এর পচ্ছর present participle বচ্ছস। 
 Adverb দ্বারা verb + ing যকদ modified হয় তচ্ছব তা present participle হচ্ছব। সহজিাচ্ছব বলা যায়, Adverb এর পচ্ছর 
(verb +ing) থাকচ্ছল তা present participle হচ্ছব। Ex: Truly speaking,------. 
22. Present participle performs the works of – [পকরবারকল্যাণ পকরদকিবকা প্রকিক্ষণাথী-৫.১১.২০১০] 
      a) noun & adjective b) verb & adjective  c) verb & adverb d) verb & noun  ⓑ 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 3 
 
                                                            
  
23. Choose the correct sentence. 
      a) A participle is a word which is partly a noun and partly an adverb. 
      b) A participle is a word which is partly a pronoun and partly a noun.  
      c) A participle is a word which is partly a verb and partly an adjective. 
      d) A participle is a word which is partly a verb and partly an adverb.      ⓒ 
24. In the sentence 'A barking dog seldom bites' the word 'barking' does the function of-  
        [সহকারী উপচ্ছজলা/থাো কিক্ষা অকিসার (মুকিচ্ছযাদ্ধা ও ক্ষুদ্র নৃ-জগাষ্ঠী জকাো) (21-08-2015)] 
      a) Noun and verb     b) Noun and adjective  
      c) Verb and adjective    d) Verb and conjunction    ⓒ 
25. Having gained truth, keep truth. [RU 06-07] 
a) gerund   b) past participle c) present participle d) perfect participle   ⓓ 
26. A rolling stone gathers no moss. Here 'rolling' is a-  [RU 13-14, 15-16] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓓ 
27. Education is the most pressing need of time. Here the word 'pressing' is [RU (E) 11-12] 
      a) verbal adjective  b) gerund   c) pronoun  d) none of the options  ⓐ 
28. Do not get into the running train. The underlined word is - [RU (F) 15-16] 
      a) Adjective  b) Verb   c) Adverb  d) Conjunction  ⓐ 
29. "The nightingale is a singing bird.' In this sentence 'singing' is a/an-  [বাংলাচ্ছদি জরলওচ্ছয় ।। ওচ্ছয়ম্যাে (10-06-2023)] 
      a) verb     b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓓ 
30. A swimming snake bit him in the leg. Here 'swimming' is a  [প্রাথকমক কবদ্যালয় সহকারী কিক্ষক কেচ্ছয়াগ পরীক্ষা-2018] 
      a) verbal noun   b) gerund  c) infinitive   d) participle   ⓓ 
31. The rain came pouring down in torrents.  [RU (Law) 06-07] 
      a) Present participle b) Perfect participle c) Past participle d) None   ⓐ 
 
 Intransitive verb (go, come, die, lie, run etc.) এর পরর present participle বরে। 
32. She went away dancing.' Here 'dancing' is: [KU 04-05] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓓ 
 
Preposition + possessive এর পচ্ছর gerund বচ্ছস। Ex: He insisted on my going there. ককন্তু জকাে Pronoun এর কেকদ বষ্ট 
possessive ো থাকচ্ছল তার পরবতী verb+ing যুি word present participle হচ্ছব। Ex: Please oblige me by all leaving 
the room. (সকচ্ছল রুম তোগ কচ্ছর আমাচ্ছর উদ্ধার/কৃতাথ ব কচ্ছরে) 
33. The underlined words here-'I have doubts about this happening at all' [RU 02-03] 
      a) Gerund   b) Participle  c) Possessive case d) Verb    ⓑ 
 
Adverb এর পচ্ছর verb +ing থাকচ্ছল তা present participle হচ্ছব। 
34. Suddenly finding himself alone, he become frightened.  [খাদ্য অকধদপ্তর || অকিস সহকারী কাম ককিউোর মুদ্রাক্ষকরক (17-02-2013)] 
      a) gerund   b) past participle c) present participle d) adverb   ⓒ 
 
Simple এ দুটি কাজ থাকচ্ছল Simple sentence এর শুরুচ্ছত প্রথম কাজটির present participle হয়। 
35. Riding a horse, he went to a distant place. Here riding is - [স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালচ্ছয়র অধীে কারা অকধদপ্তচ্ছরর কারা তত্ত্বাবধায়ক-১৩] 
      a) gerund   b) past participle c) present participle d) adverb   ⓒ 
36. Opening the file, the detective took out a newspaper cutting. Here' opening’ is a/an  
                                                                                                          [জেপ্রিাসে মন্ত্রণালয় ।। ব্যকিগত কমবকতবা (27-06-2016)] 
      a) verb    b) gerund   c) noun  d) present participle  ⓓ 
 
                           Comparison between Present Participle & Past Participle 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 4 
 
 Person জক modify করচ্ছল past participle হচ্ছব। 
 Thing জক modify করচ্ছল present participle হচ্ছব। 
          Ex: I am interested ককন্তু It is interesting, অনুরূপ, I am thrilled ককন্তু It is a thrilling story. 
37. It was a very--- situation.    [DU (C) 18-19] 
      a) embarrassing  b) embarrasse  c) embarrassed d) embarrassment  ⓐ 
38. He is quite ---with my progress. [CU (D) 13-14] 
      a) satisfy   b) satisfaction  c) satisfactory  d) satisfied   ⓓ 
39. It is always ----- when you misunderstand the customs of other countries. [DU (C) 10-11] 
a) embarrassing  b) embarrasse  c) embarrassed d) embarrassment  ⓐ 
40. I needed something to read in order not----. [CU (D) 13-14] 
      a) to bore   b) to be boring  c) to be bored  d) to be boredom  ⓒ 
বাচ্ছকের সঠিক অচ্ছথ বর জন্য I জক modify করচ্ছত হচ্ছব। তাই past participle ব্যবহার করচ্ছত হচ্ছব। 
বাচ্ছকের অথ ব: আমার ককছু একো পড়া দরকার কছল যাচ্ছত (আকম) কবরি ো হই। boring-কবরকিকর, bored-কবরি। 
41. The class bores the students. It is a ---- class. [CU (D) 10-11] 
      a) borring   b) boring  c) bored  d) boreing   ⓑ 
42. She seemed --- and ill at ease, and bent her head. [JNU (B) 13-14] 
      a) embarrass  b) embarrassing c) embarrassed  d) had    ⓒ 
 
                                           Resolve confusion between gerund and participle 
 Walking is good exercise. 
            Riding a horse, he went to a distant place. 
 
Gerund হচ্ছে verb +ing যা noun এর কাজ কচ্ছর। Walking এর পচ্ছর ‘is’ verb আচ্ছছ।তাই  Walking  এখাচ্ছে Gerund হচ্ছয়চ্ছছ। 
ককন্তু Riding a horse এর পচ্ছর কমা আচ্ছছ verb োই। এটি একটি phrase। তাই Riding  এখাচ্ছে participle হচ্ছয়চ্ছছ। 
 
 Article/Determiner এবং noun এর মাচ্ছে gerund এবং present participle জচোর উপায়। 
 Present participle হচ্ছল, Article + noun + is + verb+ing করা যাচ্ছব। (এিাচ্ছব ো করা জগচ্ছল তা gerund) 
 Gerund হচ্ছল, সাধারণত Article + noun+for+verb+ing করা যাচ্ছব। 
 
Participle: A swimming snake (A snake is swimming হয়, A snake for swimming হয় ো) 
Gerund: A swimming pool (A pool for swimming হয়, A pool is swimming হয় ো) 
Participle: A sleeping baby (A baby is sleeping হয়, A baby for sleeping হয় ো) 
Gerund: A sleeping room (A room for sleeping হয়, A room is sleeping হয় ো) 
Gerund: A sleeping pill ( A pill is sleeping হয় ো, A pill for sleeping হয়)  
প্রচ্ছে part of speech চাইচ্ছল অথবা প্রচ্ছের অপিেগুচ্ছলার মচ্ছধ্য adjective উচ্ছেখ থাকচ্ছল gerund এবং participle দুচ্ছোই 
adjective হচ্ছব। 
43. I joined a riding school. Here 'riding' is a :  [KU 10-11] 
      a) gerund            b) participle  c) verbal noun  d) infinitive                           ⓐ 
A school for riding তাই gerund হচ্ছয়চ্ছছ, a school is riding হয় ো। 
 
 complement কহচ্ছসচ্ছব verb+ing কাচ্ছজর োম বুোচ্ছল তা gerund হচ্ছব। ককন্তু কাচ্ছজর োম ো বুকেচ্ছয় verb+ing  
জদাষ শুণ, গুণ, অবস্থা বণ বোমূলক িব্দ হচ্ছল তা participle হচ্ছব। এচ্ছক্ষচ্ছে সাধারণত participle জযচ্ছহতু adjective তাই এর পূচ্ছব ব very 
বসাচ্ছো যাচ্ছব ককন্তু gerund জযচ্ছহতু noun তাই সাধারণত gerund এর পূচ্ছব ব very বসাচ্ছো যাচ্ছব ো।  
 
Gerund 
 My favourite activity is reading. 
  His profession is teaching.  
 What I detest most is smoking.  
বাকেগুচ্ছলাচ্ছত reading, teaching, smoking হচ্ছে কাচ্ছজর োম এবং এচ্ছক্ষচ্ছে এচ্ছদর পূচ্ছব ব very বচ্ছস ো। 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 5 
 
 
Participle 
 Examinations are (very) frightening.  
 The discussion was (very) enlightening (জ্ঞােগিব, জ্ঞােময়) 
 The film was (very) entertaining. 
  She is always (very) entertaining.  
বাকেগুচ্ছলাচ্ছত frightening, enlightening, entertaining হচ্ছে বণ বোমূলক িব্দ (কাচ্ছজর োম েয়)। 
44. Education is enlightening. Here 'enlightening' is: [37th BCS] 
      a) A gerund  b) A participle   c) An infinitive  d) A finite verb  ⓑ 
সাধারণত জকাচ্ছো noun/pronoun এর পচ্ছর verb+ing (modifier) থাকচ্ছল তা present participle হচ্ছব। Ex: I saw a woman 
speaking to him. (participle). 
45. The girl dancing is my daughter. The underlined word is a – [NSTU (C) 14-15] 
      a) Gerund   b) Participle  c) Preposition   d) Infinitive   ⓑ 
 
                                                                 INFINITIVE 
 
Infinitive হচ্ছে verb এর base/basic form অথবা to+base form।  
 base form জক bare infinitive বচ্ছল। 
  to সহ থাকচ্ছল তাচ্ছক to-infinitive/full infinitive বচ্ছল। 
  verb এর base form এর পূচ্ছব ব 'to' বচ্ছস full infinitive গঠে কচ্ছর। তাই এই to জক Infinitive marker বচ্ছল। 
Infinitive এর use দুই ধরচ্ছের। 
 simple infinitive (এটি noun এর কাজ কচ্ছর)  
 Gerundial or Qualifying Infinitive 
 
Use of Simple Infinitive 
1. Subject of a verb To err is human. 
2. Object of a verb He likes to swim. 
3. Complement of a verb To see is to believe. 
4. Object of a Preposition He is about to die. 
5. Objective Complement I saw him go. 
 
Use of Gerundial Infinitive 
Adjective: To qualify a noun This house is to let. 
Adverb: To qualify verb/adjective We eat to live. It's good to eat. 
Absolute: To qualify a sentence To tell the truth, I don't trust you. 
46. The base form of a verb is called - 
      a) an infinitive   b) weak  c) verb   d) strong verb   ⓐ 
47. 'I will not let you go.' In this sentence 'go' is a/an-  
      a) infinitive   b) gerund  c) transitive verb d) participle   ⓐ 
48. We want to take legal action against the hoodlum. Here in this sentence 'to' is a/an- 
      a) Adverb    b) Infinitive marker  c) Preposition   d) Conjunction  ⓑ  
49. A simple infinitive does the work of a/an- 
      a) Adverb    b) Noun  c) Adjective  d) Verb    ⓑ 
50. I loved to play chess when I was at college. Here 'to play' is a/an  
      a) participle  b) infinitive  c) gerund  d) noun   ⓑ 
51. To err is human. What is the underlined part called? 
      a) Gerund   b) verbal noun  c) infinitive  d) participle   ⓒ 
 
                                                                 PRACTICE MCQ 
52. The old man is tired of walking'. Here 'walking' is a/an- 
      a) present participle  b) adjective  c) common noun d) gerund    ⓓ 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                 Verb, Page | 6 
 
53. The word 'flying' in the sentence 'Look at the flying bird' is- 
      a) gerund   b) participle  c) verbal noun  d) gerundial infinitive  ⓑ 
54. Flying kites is my favourite hobby. The underlined word does the function of- 
      a) verb   b) adverb  c) adjective  d) noun   ⓐ 
Gerund, object কেচ্ছল অথবা এর পচ্ছরর adjective/adverb দ্বারা modified হচ্ছল তা verb এর মচ্ছতা কাজ কচ্ছর। ককন্তু উি gerund 
phrase টি noun (phrase) কহচ্ছসচ্ছব কাজ কচ্ছর।  
55. 'A lost opportunity never returns -.' Here 'lost' is a c) participle 
      a) gerund   b) verbal noun  c) participle   d) gerundial infinitive  ⓒ 
56. A retired officer lives next door. Here, the underlined word is used as a/an: [38th BCS] 
      a) Gerund   b) adverb  c) preposition  d) participle   ⓓ 
lost, retired এরা past participle কারণ এটি article এবং noun এর মধ্যবতী word  যা adjective. 
57. Going there he found his friend absent. Here 'going' is a 
      a) gerund    b) noun  c) present participle d) past participle  ⓒ 
58. What is the correct use of gerund? 
       a) I saw the girl dancing.    b) I am dancing on the floor. 
       c) Dancing is good exercise.   d) The girl came here dancing.   ⓒ 
59. ----- eggs were served to the players. 
      a) Boiled   b) Boil   c) To boil  d) Boiling   ⓐ 
60. Making a good result in the exam needs a lot of hard work. Here 'making' is a  
      a) present participle  b) pronoun   c) adjective          d) gerund    ⓓ 
61. He started reading. The underlined word is called: 
      a) adverb       b) participle   c) gerund  d) noun   ⓒ 
62. Tom rather----. What shall we do to cheer him up? 
      a) depressing   b) depressed   c) depressingly  d) depression   ⓑ 
63. Walking in the morning is good for health. This is 
      a) adverb       b) participle   c) gerund  d) noun   ⓒ 
64. I found the boy reading a book. Here 'reading' is 
      a) Present participle b) Noun  c) gerund  d) perfect participle 
সাধারণত জকাচ্ছো noun/pronoun এর পচ্ছর verb+ing (modifier) থাকচ্ছল তা present participle হচ্ছব। 
65. Don't disturb a sleeping baby. Here 'sleeping' is a: 
      a) perfect participle  b) pronoun   c) adjective          d) verbal adjective  ⓓ 
66. We enjoyed swimming in the river. Here 'swimming' is a/an: 
      a) present participle  b) pronoun   c) adjective          d) gerund   ⓓ 
67. Hearing the noise, the boy woke up. Here the word 'hearing' is a/an-  
      a) present participle  b) pronoun   c) perfect participle   d) gerund   ⓐ 
68. He is fond of fishing. The underlined part is a/an- 
      a) present participle  b) pronoun   c) adjective          d) gerund   ⓓ 
69. I like reading literature. Here 'reading' is: 
      a) present participle  b) pronoun   c) adjective          d) gerund   ⓓ 
70. The machine made in Japan is now working well. Here 'made' is 
      a) Present participle b) Perfect participle c) Past participle d) gerund   ⓒ 
71. Betrayed by his friends, he started living alone. Here 'betrayed' is a: 
      a) Present participle b) Perfect participle c) Past participle d) gerund   ⓒ 
72. Which of the following sentence does not have a gerund (জজরাল্ড)? 
      a) I see a sleeping child.     b) He fancies visiting the Eiffel tower. 
      c) Walking in the morning is good for health. d) Please stop writing.     ⓐ

Farhan Sensei                                                                                                                                                      Tense, Page | 1 
 
                                                                 TENSE 
 
                                                                              PRESENT INDEFINITE 
 Present Indefinite : বর্তমানে ক ানো  াজ  রা, অভ্যাসগর্  মত অথবা চিরন্তে সর্য কবাঝানে এবং সুচেচদতষ্ট সময় উনেখ ো  নর 
বান য যচদ {always, often, usually, hardly, seldom, generally, normally, sometimes, occasionally, At 
times, daily, regularly, frequently, every morning/day/week/month/year/time, on holidays. on 
(Fridays/Sundays) ইর্যাচদ থান  র্াহনে verb টি present indefinite tense হনব।  
 Present Indefinite: দুটি চিরন্তে সর্য, ববজ্ঞাচে  সর্য, অভ্যাসগর্  নমতর বা য when দ্বারা যুক্ত হনে দুটিই present indefinite 
tense হয়। 
 Structure: Sub+ verb এর base form + object + Ext. 
1. When water ----, it turns into ice. [KU (SS) 11-12, RU (E. চবনজাড়) 16-17, BSMRSTU (D) 17-18, পচরসংখ্যাে  মত র্তা-১৭ 38th BCS] 
       a) will freeze  b) freezes   c) would freeze  d) froze ⓑ 
2. Ice ---- on water.  (বাংোনদশ পেী উন্নয়ে কবার্ত (চবআরচর্চব): ২৩  
       a) Flot   b) Flotting   c) Floats  d) Floten  ⓒ 
3. The boy (Play) Football.  (ঔষধ প্রশাসে অচধদপ্তর (অচিস সহায় ) ২২ 
       a) Playing   b) Plays   c) Playes  d) Play   ⓑ 
4. The earth ----- round the sun.   (B36th BCS ঔষধ প্রশাসে অচধদপ্তর (অচিস সহায় ) ২২ 
       a) moved   b) moves   c) has move  d) will be moving ⓑ 
5. The virtuous (be) always happy. Medical-2005-06 
       a) have been  b) are    c) is   d) none  ⓑ 
6. She usually ----- the baby down for sleep at this time. BSC 3 Banks SO-2018 
       a) lays   b) lay    c) lied   d) lies   ⓐ 
7. He often ------ newspapers but he has never ---- a novel. (DU A-Unit, 2007-08) 
       a) reads, read  b) read, read   c) reads, reads  d) read, reads.   ⓐ 
8. The news ---- always bad now-a-days. (Dhaka University (2000-2001) 
       a) are   b) is    c) was   d) were  ⓑ 
9. We often ---- a victim of circumstances.  DU-(D-Unit), 2001-02 
       a) fallen   b) felt    c) did fall  d) fall   ⓓ 
10. The man seldom (smoke). [কো টা  দাচিৎ ধুমপাে  নর/ধুমপাে  নরই-ো]  [HSTU (C) 14-15] 
       a) smoking  b) has smoked   c) smokes  d) to smoke  ⓒ 
11. Rabindranath's stories often ---- surprise endings. [DU (D) 00-01, প্রা -প্রাথচম  সহ। চশক্ষ -১৬] 
      a) have had  b) had    c) have   d) has   ⓒ 
12. He ---- up at 7 O'clock every morning. (কস প্রনর্যহ স াে ৭টায় ঘুম কথন  উনে) [RU (গণনযাগানযাগ) 06-07] 
      a) got   b) getting   c) get   d) gets   ⓓ 
13. Karim ---- to school regularly. (পাচে উন্নয়ে কবার্ত অচিস সহায় -১৫, কৃচষ সম্প্রসারণ অচধদপ্তনর সহ ারী কৃচষ  মত র্তা-১৬)  
Your brother (go) to school regularly. (কর্ামার ভ্াই চেয়চমর্ স্কুনে যায়) [RU (Law) 03-04] 
      a) goes   b) had gone   c) went   d) going  ⓐ 
14. Alam always ---- the truth. [NSI এর ওয়ািার  েনেবে-১৯] 
      a) speak   b) speaks   c) spoken  d) spoked  ⓑ 
15. I usually ---- breakfast at 6:30 in the morning.  
      a) eat   b) ate    c) had   d) took   ⓐ 
16. John ----- tennis once or twice a week. [সহ সচিব (আইে, ড্রািটিং)-০৫] 
He ---- tennis twice a week. (কস সপ্তানহ দুইচদে কটচেস কখনে) (DU (B) 97-98, IU (H) 08-09, JU (গ) 09-10) 
      a) is playing usually  b) usually plays  c) is usually playing d) plays usually ⓑ 
17. He dress formally to work but he always ----. [DU (B) 07-08, IU (F) 10-11, JU (8) 10-11] 
      a) has not to, has      b) does not have to, does  
      c) has got to, would not     d) does not require to, would   ⓑ 
18. I ---- at six o'clock, but ---- to be by five. [DU (A) 14-15] 
      a) get normally up - I sometime have   b) normally get up - sometimes I have 
      c) get normally up - sometimes I    d) normally get up - I have sometimes ⓑ 

Farhan Sensei                                                                                                                                                      Tense, Page | 2 
 
19. When metal becomes hot, it ----. (ধাতু যখে উত্তপ্ত হয় র্খে র্া প্রসাচরর্ হয়। [BU (B) 11-12] 
      a) expanded  b) expands   c) expanding  d) expand  ⓑ 
20. I still feel very tired ---- in the morning. [CU (D) 06-07, (F1) 15-16] 
      a) when I wake up      b) when I will wake up    
      c) as I wake up      d) while I wake up    ⓐ 
 
 
                                                                           PRESENT CONTINUOUS 
 Present Continuous: Now, right now, at present, at this time/moment, today, this season, this year, still, 
day by day, gradually, rapidly, year after year ইর্যাচদ উনেখ থা নে এবং বর্তমানে ক ানো  াজ িেনে বুঝানে verb টি 
present continuous tense. 
 Present Continuous: খুব চে ট ভ্চবষ্যনর্ ঘটনর্ যানে এমে  াজ চেনদতশ  রনর্ present continuous tense  হয়। এনক্ষনে 
ভ্চবষ্যৎ সময় াে (কযমে (next week/month/year or any near future time) ব্যবচহর্ হয় 
 Structure: Sub + am/is/are + (verb এর ing) + object + Ext. 
1. The prices of rice are ----. ২৮র্ম চবচসএস 
      a) raising   b) risen   c) rising  a) sings  ⓒ

                                                                  FUTURE TENSE 
 বান য tomorrow, next (time, day, month, year) থা নে verb এর future indefinite tense হয়। 
 Short-cut: Will/Shall + base form  
                Ex: I will go to school tomorrow.      She will visit her aunt next week. 
 
 বান য ভ্চবষ্যৎ সময় জ্ঞাপ  শব্দ কযমে: By this time, By (time, month, year), By then, Next (time, month, year) 
ইর্যাচদ থা নে verb এর future perfect tense হয়। 
 Short-cut: Will/Shall + have + V3  
                Ex: I will have finished the work by this time tomorrow.  
                         আগামীকাকলর এই সমকয়র মকধ্য আহম কাজটি লিষ ককর ল লব। 
 
 বান য ভ্চবষ্যৎ সময় জ্ঞাপ  শব্দ By the time দ্বারা যখে (দুটি clause) যুক্ত থান  র্খে By the time এর পনর present 
indefinite এবং অপর অংনশ future indefinite/perfect/perfect continuous tense হয়। 
‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍Ex: By the time he comes, we will start the meeting. 
                         → লস আসার আকগই আমরা হমটিিং শুরু করব। (Future Indefinite) 
                Ex: By the time she finishes the work, I will have gone home. 
                         → লস কাজ লিষ করার আকগই আহম বাসায় িকল র্াব। (Future Perfect)

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                Subject-Verb-Agreement, Page | 1 
 
                              SUBJECT-VERB-AGREEMENT 
 
                                                             SINGULAR OR PLURAL 
Subject Verb Agreement -এর সাধারণ নিয়ম হল া Subject যনি Singular হয় তাহল  Verb টিও Singular হয়। Subject Plural 
হল  Verb টিও Plural হয়।  
■ Subject-Verb-Agreement সাধারণত number ও person এর উপলর নির্ভর কলর।  
■ ককিিা Subject এর Number ও person পনরবতভি করা হল  Verb এর রূপ পনরবনতভত হয়। 
 Noun যনি plural হয় তাহল  Noun এর সালে s বা es যুক্ত হয়।  
 নকন্তু Verb singular হল  Verb এর সালে s বা es যুক্ত হয়।  
 Adjective এর সালে কখলিা s বা es যুক্ত হয় িা। 
1. 'Subject-Verb Agreement' refers to ---  
       a) person only     b) number and person  
       c) number, person and gender   d) number only     ⓑ  
2. The big room --- air-conditioned. (বড় কক্ষটি শীতাতপ নিয়নিত)  
       a) is   b) are   c) should  d) do    ⓐ 
3. The headmaster ---- to speak to you. (প্রধাি নশক্ষক কতামার সালে কো ব লত চাি/চালেি)  
       a) wants   b) is wanting   c) was wanting  d) has wanting   ⓐ 
4. This book --------- to my uncle. (বইটি আমার চাচার/মামার) 
       a) belonging   b) belongs  c) was belonging  d) is belonging  ⓑ 
5. Monir – Yashim because she is kind to him. 
      a) is liking   b) has liked  c) was liking  d) likes    ⓓ 
Like, belong, want, see, hear, taste ইতযানি verb এর continuous tense হয় িা। কারণ এইগুল া stative verb. 
6. These grapes---- sour. (এই আঙ্গুরগুল া টক)  
       a) tasting   b) are tasting   c) tastes  d) taste    ⓓ 
সাধারণত taste এর continuous tense হয় িা।  
7. -----there any nursing schools --- Chittagong?  
       a) Is, at    b) Are, on   c) Was, in   d) Are, in   ⓓ 
8. The memoranda ---- not important. (স্মারকগুল া গুরুত্বপূণভ িয়)  
       a) has   b) is   c) have   d) are    ⓓ 
9. Where --- all the boys----? (সব কেল রা ককাোয় নিলয়লে?)  
       a) has, gone  b) have, gone  c) did, went   d) does, go   ⓑ 
10. Those ----- the type I like. (ঐগুন  আমার পেলের ধরি িয়) 
       a) isn't   b) aren't  c) won't  d) don't   ⓑ 
 
                                                      AND - CONNECTED SUBJECTS 
দুই বা তলতানধক Singular subject যখি and দ্বারা যুক্ত হয় তখি Verb টি plural হয়।    Ex: Fire and water do not agree. 
■ ‘And’ যারা একানধক common noun, subject নহসালব যুক্ত হল  যনি কসই একানধক noun এর পূলবভ article োলক তাহল  verb টি 
plural হলব আর যনি শুধু প্রেমটির পূলবভ article োলক তাহল  verb টি হলব singular. কযমি- 
   Ex: The headmaster and chairman of the school committee has come here  
   Ex: The headmaster and the chairman of the school committee have come here 
■And দ্বারা যুক্ত একানধক noun যনি একক ব্যনক্ত বা একক র্াব/ধারণা/বস্তু কবাঝায় তাহল  এলির verb টি singular হলব। 
Ex: Bread and Butter is my favorite food.        Slow and steady wins the race.  
          Bread and butter is necessary for all.         The sum and substance of the story is this.  
          My name and address is given here.  
          Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.

       a) are   b) was   c) has   d) have been   ⓒ

                                            SUBJUNCTIVE VERB 
Subject যখন প্রত্যাশা করে যয অন্য যকউ এই কাজটা করুক ত্খন subordinate clause এে verb টি মূল form-এ হয় মানে base form 
ব্যবহাে হয়। ইহারকই Subjunctive বলা হয়। 
In simply, চাওয়া বা ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ কেরত্ subordinate clause এ base form ব্যবহারেে জাতত্ই হরচ্ছ Present Subjunctive.  
 
Verbs: Advise, ask, command, demand, decree, insist, move, prefer, propose, request, require, suggest, 
stipulate, urge ইত্যাতি। 
Adjectives: Important, imperative, mandatory, necessary, obligatory, proposed, recommended, suggested, 
urgent ইত্যাতি।  
Nouns: Demand, insistence, preference, proposal, recommendation, request, requirement, suggestion ইত্যাতি। 
                                                       
             
                                                         R U P A    I S    M O D E R N 
R Request / Requirement / Recommend 
U Urge / Urgent 
P Propose / Proposal / Prefer / Preference 
A Ask / Advise 
 
I Insist / Insistence / Important / Imperative 
S Suggest / Suggestion / Stipulate 
 
M Move / Mandatory 
O Obligatory 
D Demand / Decree 
E Essential 
N Necessary word 
 
উরেতখত্ এসব verb/adjective/noun যতি Principal clause থারক এবং এরিে পরেই that যুক্ত subordinate clause বা that 
clause থারক ত্াহরল that clause এে subject এে পরে সব বিাই verb এে base form হরব এবং Negative এে যেরে base form এে 
পূরব ব শুধু not বসরব। be verb এে যেরে শুধু be বসরব। কােণ, British Engish এ should + base form ব্যবহৃত্ হরয় থারক তকন্তু 
American English এ should যক উহয োখা হয়। 
 
                                           that + subject + verb এে simple form ব্যবহৃত্ হয়। 
Ex: Congress has decreed that the gasoline tax be abolished.  
       We proposed that he take a vacation. 
       I move that we adjourn until this afternoon. 
 
                                     তকন্তু that + subject না থাকরল infinite ব্যবহৃত্ হয়। 
Ex: We urge that he leave now. 
       We urge him to leave now. (এখানে that োই infinite হনয়নে।) 
 
                                  মরন োখরব, that ো থাকনে Suggest এে পে gerund হয়। 
Ex: I suggest that I do it now. 
       I suggest doing it now. (এখানে that োই gerund হনয়নে।) 
 Subjunctive word এে পে that তিরয় যয subjectটি থাকরব ত্া যতি যকানো passive sense প্রকাশ করে, ত্রব প্রথরম be এবংত্াে 
পরে verb- এে past participle form থাকরব। 
Ex: I recommend that the letter be written.  
       I suggest that the job be done  
       I request that the story be retold.

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                Voice, Page | 1 
 
 
    VOICE 
 
VOICE এর সাধারণত 4 জায়গায় ভুল হয়য় থায়ে। 
 
 Subject = object  
 Auxiliary verb  
 Main verb   
 Preposition  
 
                                                                     SHORTCUT TECHNIQUE 
                                         
 Be verb 8 টি (am, is, are, was, were, be, been, being). 
 Preposition সাধারণত By হয়। 
 Main Verb always  ( V3 =past participle ) হয়ে। 
 Modal Auxiliary verb = (can, could, may, might, will, would, shall, should, ought to, used to, must) 
 Semi-Modal Verbs: {Have to, has to (am to, is to, are to, was to, were to) Need to, Used to, Ought to, 
Be going to} 
 
                     ACTIVE                     PASSIVE 
1. Continuous Tense হয়ল (verb এর সায়থ ing ) হয়ল  Being  হয়ে 
2. Perfect Continuous Tense হয়ল  Being  হয়ে 
3. Have, Has, Had  হয়ল  Have, Has, Had  + been হয়ে 
4. Modal/ Semi-Modal verbs হয়ল  Modal/ Semi-Modal + be হয়ে 
5. Be verb + going to হয়ল  Be verb + going to + be হয়ে 
6. Please , kindly হয়ল  Y ou are requested to / You are requested not to হয়ে 
7. who   By / TO / With Whom  + Auxiliary   
 Who + Auxiliary 
8. Whom  Who + Auxiliary 
9. a) What + do/ does/ did 
      b)  What + verb 
 a) What + am/ is/ are/ was/ were 
 b) By what + auxiliary 
10. Why/ When/ Where/ How  Why/ When/ Where/ How + auxiliary 
 
    
                                                                          IMPERATIVE SENTENCES 
 Verb দ্বারা sentence শুরু হয়। 
 
        Passive েরার সময় 
 Positive : Let  
 Negative : Let not / Let + pronoun + not 
 Auxiliary verb হহসায়ে = be হয়ে 
 Never থােয়ল = Let not / Let never 
 যে সেল Imperative Sentence দ্বারা নৈহতে ো োস্তহেে অপহরহাে য উপয়েশ যোঝায় যস সেল যেয়ে Let ৈা থােয়ল should 
be ব্যেহার েয়র Passive voice েরা োয়। 
Ex:  Active: Obey your parants         Passive: your parents should be obeyed.       
 
 
    

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                Voice, Page | 2 
 
 
                                                                                 PRACTICE MCQ 
1. He is known to me' is an example of- [ৈাহসিং -২০] 
     a) compound sentence b) active voice  c) complex sentence  d) passive voice ⓓ

     a) passive voice     b) compound sentence  
     c) active voice     d) complex sentence      ⓐ

     a) He is liked by all his pupils.   b) He was liked by all his pupils.  
     c) He is being liked by all his pupils.  d) He is like by all his pupils.    ⓐ

     a) Novels read by us.    b) Novels are read by us.    ⓑ 
     c) Novels read by we.    d) Novels are being read by us.

     a) He run a race  b) He ran a race  c) He is to race      d) He runs a race ⓑ

     a) Rupa was sung a song.    b) Rupa sings a song.  
     c) Rupa sang a song.    d) Rupa şung a song.     ⓒ

    c) Idle people are not like by us.   d) Idle people are not of our liking.    ⓑ

      c) Mice have been killed by cats.   d) Mice are being killed by cats.    ⓑ 
 
Continuous Tense হয়ল (verb এর সায়থ ing ) হয়ল    Being  হয়ে

      b) All arrangements are making by the city planner. 
      c) The all arrangements had been making by the city planner.

      c) Kites were being flowing by them.  d) Kites was being flown by them.    ⓐ 
17. I shall be teaching him.' োেযটির Passive form হয়ে।   [প্রাথহমে হেদ্যালয় প্রধাৈ হশেে হৈয়য়াগ পরীো-09]

a) Tea will be being taken by us.   b) Tea should be being taken by us.

Active voice & Imperative sentence এর verb এর দুইটি object থােয়ল  
                                      Passive voice এ Let এর পয়র

        c) what was wanted by you?   d) what is wanting by you?    ⓑ 
109. The correct passive form of 'What made the noise?" is- 
        a) By what was the noise made?   b) By what the noise was made?  
       c) What was made the noise?   d) What was the noise made?    ⓐ 
 
      Why/ When/ Where/ How Why/ When/ Where/ How + auxiliary 
110. Change the voice-'Where did you see him?" 
        a) Where did he seen by you?   b) Where was he see by you? 
        c) Where was seen by you?   d) Where was he seen by you?   ⓓ 
111. How can you do this? োেযটির Passive form হয়ে-  
        a) How this can be done by you?  b) How could this be done by you? 
        c) How can this be done by you?  d) How this could be done by you?   ⓒ 
112. Choose the correct passive form: "Why did your brother write such a letter?" 
        a) Why was such a letter written by your brother?   
        b) Why such a letter was written by your brother? 
        c) Why such a letter was written by your brother.  
        d) Why was such a letter been written by your brother?      ⓐ 
113. What is the passive form of 'When did he finish the work'? 
        a) When the work was finished by him?  b) When did the work finished by him? 
        c) When was the work to be finished by him? d) When was the work finished by him?   ⓓ 
 
 
                                                    উহয “to” সহ Passive Voice-এর ব্যহতক্রম হৈয়ম 
Active voice এ see, hear, make, help ইতযাহে verb এর object এর পয়র verb এর base form থােয়ল Passive voice এ 
হদ্বতীয় verb (base form) এর পূয়ে য উহয থাো to েসায়ত হয়। যেমৈ:  
       Active: He made me drive his car.           Passive: I was made to drive his car by him. 
114. The passive form of the sentence "You made him cook rice" is-  
        a) He was made to cook rice.   b) He was made cook rice. 
        c) He had made to cook rice.   d) He is made to cook rice.    ⓐ 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                Voice, Page | 12 
 
 
 
 
115. He heard her sing. The passive voice of the sentence is  
        a) She was heard to sing by him.  b) She was heard sing by him. 
        c) She was heard to sing.   d) She was heard to be sung.    ⓐ 
116. The passive form of the sentence ‘I saw him go’. 
        a) He is seen to go by me.   b) He was seen to go by me. 
        c) He is being go by me.    d) He has seen to go by me.    ⓑ 
117. Choose the right passive form of "They made him tell them everything."  
        a) He was made by them to tell them everything.  
        b) He was made to tell them everything. 
        c) He was made by them to tell everything to them.  
        d) Everything was made to be told them by him.       ⓑ 
 
 
                                                    PASSIVE VOICE WITH INDEFINITE SUBJECTS 
*One, No one, Nobody, Everyone, Everybody ইতযাহে Indefinite pronoun গুয়লা Passive voice এ উয়ে োয়। 
*People েহে Active voice এর Subject হয় তয়ে তা Passive voice এ সাধারণত উঠিয়য় হেয়ত হয়। 
118. Change the voice of "One should keep one's promise". 
        a) One's promise should be kept.   b) One's promise should be kept by one. 
        c) A promise should be kept.   d) Promise should be kept.    ⓒ 
119. The passive voice of 'One should take care of one's health." 
        a) One's health should be taken care of.  b) One's health should be taken care of by one 
        c) Health should be taken care of.  d) Health should be taken care.   ⓒ 
120. Find the passive voice: Somebody should have called the president this morning. 
        a) The president should have been called this morning. 
        b) The president could have been called this morning  
        c) The president might have been called this morning 
        d) The president could be called this morning        ⓐ 
121. The correct active voice of "That house has not been lived in for years' is - 
        a) No one has been living in that house for years.  b) No one ever lived in that house for years. 
        c) Nobody has for years lived in that house.      
        d) Nobody had been living in that house for years.        ⓒ 
122. Change the voice of 'Nobody knows him here.'  
        a) He is known by nobody here.    b) Nobody known him here. 
        c) He is not known here.     d) He is known here.      ⓒ 
123. People always remember the patriots. Which one is correct passive.  
        a) The patriot will always remembered by people. b) The patriots are always being remembered. 
        c) People are always remembered by the patriots. d) The patriots are always remembered.  ⓓ 
124. The passive form of "The people in Asia mainly eat rice" is- 
        a) Rice is mainly eaten in Asia   b) Rice is manly ate in Asia. 
        c) Rice is mainly eaten by Asia.   d) Asia is mainly eaten by rice.   ⓐ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                Voice, Page | 13 
 
 
                                                     QUASI-PASSIVE VOICE 
Quasi-passive voice: Complement যুি Active যে Passive এ রূপান্তর।  
count, feel, look, sell, smell taste, read, sound, write ইতযাহে Quasi-passive verb গুয়লার পয়র Complement থােয়ল 
এয়ের passive voice হৈম্নরূয়প হয়য় থায়ে।  
Active: Subject + Quasi-passive verb + complement (adjective) 
Passive: Subject অপহরেহতযত + is/was complement + when (it is/was) + past participle (V3)  
        তয়ে Subject টি plural হয়ল is/was এর স্থ্য়ল are/were এেিং it এর স্থ্য়ল they হয়ে। 
125. Choose the correct passive form of the sentence: Iron feels hard.  
        a) Iron is hard by it is felt   b) Iron is hard when it is felt 
        c) Hard feels by Iron    d) Iron was hard     ⓑ 
126. The correct passive voice of 'The pill tastes bitter' is  
        a) The pill is bitter when it is tasted  b) The pill is bitter when it was tasted 
        c) The pill is bitter when it tasted  d) The pill is bitter when it tastes   ⓐ 
127. The passive form of 'Rice sells cheap' is (চাল সস্তায় হেহক্র হয়)  
        a) Rice is sold cheap    b) Rice is cheap when it is sold 
        c) Rice is being sold cheap.   d) Rice is cheap when it is selling.   ⓑ 
128. Honey tastes sweet. What is the passive form of the sentence? 
        a) Honey is tasted sweet    b) Honey is sweet when it is tasted  
        c) It is sweet when honey is tasted  d) Honey is sweet to taste    ⓑ 
129. Find the correct passive voice of the sentence 'Roses smell sweet' 
        a) Roses are sweet smelling which someone smells. b) Roses are sweet when smelt. 
        c) Roses are sweet when we smell.   d) Roses are smelling sweet.   ⓑ 
 
                         INFINITIVE TO PASSIVE: HIDDEN PASSIVE STRUCTURES 
*Active: It is time + to + verb (V₁) + object       e.g. It is time to do your duty  
  Passive: It is time + for + object + to be +V ,     e.g. It is time for your duty to be done. 
*Active এ There +is/are/was/were+ something to do থােয়ল passive এ to be done েরয়ত হয়ে  
  Active: There is a lot of work to do.  Passive: There is a lot of work to be done. 
  Active: There is no money to waste. Passive: There is no money to be wasted 
  Active: There is no time to lose.  Passive: There is no time to be lost. 
 
130. The passive form is- It is time to shut up the shop. 
        a) It is time to be shut up the shop.  b) It is time to shut the shop up. 
        c) It is time for the shop to be shut up.  d) It is time the shop be shut up.   ⓒ 
131. There are lots of things to do' (অয়ৈে হেছু েরার আয়ে) The passive form of the sentence above is- 
        a) There are lots of things to done.  b) There are lots of things to be doing. 
        c) There are lots of things to be done.  d) None of them.     ⓒ

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                           Page | 1 
 
 
                                                                  NARRATION 
 
◆Narration: বক্তা যা বলে তাই Speech বা Narration. Narration বা Speech দুই প্রকার। যথাাঃ 
A. Direct Narration 
বক্তার উক্তক্ত ক্তিলে/সরাসক্তর প্রকাশ করলে তালক কক Direct Narration বলে। 
       Ex: He said to me, "Can you do these sums for me?" 
 
B. Indirect Narration. 
       বক্তার কথা সরাসক্তর প্রকাক্তশত িা হলে যখি পলরাক্ষভালব প্রকাশ পাে তখি তালক Indirect Narration বলে। 
       Ex: He asked me if I could do those sums for him     
 
 ◆Narration Change করার সমে ক্তিলনাক্ত ক্তবষেগুলো মলি রাখলত হলব। 
Sentence অথ থগত ক্তিক ক্তিলে পাঁচ প্রকার। যথা 
a) Assertive Sentence (ক্তববৃক্ততবাকয) 
b) Interrogative Sentence (প্রশ্নবাকয) 
c) Imperative Sentence (অনুজ্ঞাসূচক বাকয) 
d) Optative Sentence (ইচ্ছাপ্রকাশক বাকয) 
e) Exclamatory Sentence (ক্তবস্মেসূচক বাকয) 
 
 
                                                      He said to me, "Can you do these sums for me?" 
 
                                                       Reporting Verb           Reporting Speech   
 
                                              Practice: He asked me if I could do those sums for him     
                                            
■ Reporting Speech এর অন্তগ থত first person সবসমে Reporting Verb এর subject এর person অনুযােী পক্তরবক্ততথত হে।  
■ Reporting Speech এর অন্তগ থত second person সবসমে Reporting Verb এর object এর person অনুযােী পক্তরবক্ততথত হে। 
■ Reporting Speech এর অন্তগ থত third person এর ককালিা পক্তরবতথি হে িা। 
 
 
                          DIRECT SPEECH                       INDIRECT SPEECH 
1. am, is, are  was, were 
2. have, has  had 
3. was, were  had been 
4. V1  V2 
5. V₂  had + V3 
6. must  Had to (had to িা থাকলে must ব্যবহার করা যালব) 
7. may, can, shall, will  might, could, should, would  
8. good+ morning/ evening/ afternoon/ luck   wish/ wished  
9. good+ night/ bye/ farewell   bid/ bade 
10. Thank/ congratulations! / welcome   thanked/ congratulated/ welcomed  
 
 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                           Page | 2 
 
 
                                                      NARRATION OF ASSERTIVE SENTENCE 
 Assertive Sentence এর প্রথলম Sub এবং কশলষ full Stop (•) থাকলব। 
 Ex→ Naruto said to Hinata, 'I want to go to Leaf village.' 
 Inverted comma উলে ক্তগলে = that বসলব। 
 Reporting Verb টি said / told এ পক্তরবক্ততথত হে। 
[object থাকালে say/ said to হে, আর িা থাকলে say/ said হলব। told এর পলর কখলিা to বলস িা।]        
1. Meena said to me, 'I want to go to Dhaka now.' The indirect speech of the sentence is  
    a) Meena said to me that she wanted to go to Dhaka now    
    b) Meena said to me that she wanted to go to Dhaka then. 
    c) Meena told to me that she wanted to go to Dhaka then.   
    d) Meena told to me that she had wanted to go to Dhaka then.      ⓑ 
2. The correct narration of "He said, I am well"-  
    a) He said that I am well.     b) He said that I was well. 
    c) He said that he was well.    d) He said that he is well.   ⓒ 
3. My friend said, "I was ill."(Change the narration) 
    a) My friend said that he was ill.    b) My friend told that I was ill. 
    c) My friend said that he had been ill.    d) My friend said that I were ill.  ⓒ 
4. Rahim said, "I am ill." (Change the narration) 
    a) Rahim said that he is ill.     b) Rahim told about his illness 
    c) Rahim described that his state of health   d) Rahim said that he was ill    ⓓ 
5. You said to me, ‘you do not do your duty’. Make indirect speech- 
    a) You told me that I do not my duty.   b) You said to me that I do not do my duty. 
    c) You said to me that I do not do my duty.  d) You told me that I did not do my duty.  ⓓ 
6. You said to me, 'You are right'? Indirect from is - 
    a) You told that you are right    b) You told me that I was right. 
    c) You told me that I am right.    d) You told me that you were right.  ⓑ 
7. Select the correct indirect form: He said to me, "You are always unreliable." 
    a) He said to me that I am going to be unreliable.  b) He told me that I was always unreliable. 
    c) He told me I had been always unreliable.  d) He told me that I would be unreliable. ⓑ 
8. The correct indirect speech of He said, "I finished reading the book." is  
    a) He said that he finished reading the book.  
    b) He said that he had finished reading the book. 
    c) He said that he have had finished reading the book.   
    d) He said that he finished to have read the book.        ⓑ

9. Change the sentence from direct speech to indirect. He said, "The horse died in the night."  
    a) He said that the horse died in the night    
    b) He said that the horse had died in the night.  
    c) He said that the horse was died in the night.    
    d) He said that the horse will be died in the night.        ⓑ 
10. He said, "The train reached at nine." What is the correct indirect from of the sentence. 
      a) He said that the train has reached at nine.   b) He said that the train reached at nine. 
      c) He said that the train had reached at nine.  d) He said that train reached at nine.  ⓒ 
11. He said, "I went to Tangail." (Indirect) a) He said that had he gone to Tangail. 
      a) He said that he had gone to Tangail.   b) He said that I had gone to Tangail. 
      c) He said that he went to Tangail.     d) He said that had he gone to Tangail. ⓐ
