      a) told to her professors      b) told her professors 
      c) said her professors.     d) is telling her professors.   ⓑ 
Source: CLIFFS TOEFL MINI TEST 4 Part A Question No. 5 Page no. 232 কত হুবুহু কিখুি। 
told +object, said to +object; শুধু said এর পর object বলস িা, আবার told এর পলর to বলস িা। 
13. He said that he had come to see me. এর direct speech- 
      a) He said, "he has come to see you."   b) He said, "I came to see you." 
      c) He said, "I have come to see you."   d) He said, "I had come to see you."   ⓒ 
14. He said "I met her long ago." The correct indirect speech is: 
      a) He said that he had met her long ago.   b)  He said that he was met her long ago.  
      c) He said that he has met her long ago.    d) He said that he met her long ago.  ⓐ 
15. Itachi told us that he had waited an hour. বাকযটির direct speech হলব- 
      a) Itachi said to us, 'I have been waiting an hour.  b) Itachi said to us, I waited an hour. 
      c) Itachi said to us, 'I had to wait an hour.   d) Itachi told to us, 'I have waited an hour.  ⓑ 
(Indirect told থাকলে direct এ said to হে)  
16. Correct indirect speech of - Shumi said, "I was suffering from fever." is- 
      a) Shumi said that she was suffering from fever.       
      b) Shumi said that she had suffering from fever. 
      c) Shumi said that she had been suffering from fever.       
      d) Shumi said that she was being suffered from fever.       ⓒ 
17. He said, "I have been working since sunrise." Make it indirect speech. 
      a) He said that he has been working since sunrise. b) He said that he has worked for sunrise. 
      c) He said that he had been working since sunrise. d) He said that he is working since sunrise. ⓒ 
18. He said that he had been writing a letter. Make it direct - 
      a) He said, "I wrote a letter."    b) He said,"I have written a letter." 
      c) He said, "I was writing a letter."   d) He said, "I write a letter."   ⓒ 
19. He said that he had seen him long before. Which one is the correct direct form? 
      a) He said, "I saw him long ago."    b) He said, "I did see him long ago." 
      c) He said, "I have seen him long before."  d) He said, "I had seen him long before."  ⓐ 
Indirect এ before থাকলে direct এ ago হে। আর long ago থাকলে verb এর past indefinite tense হে। 
20. Indirect speech of: "when I got home, I found I had lost my umbrella," Laila said. 
    a) Laila said that when she had got home she found that she had lost her umbrella.  
    b) Laila said that when she got home she found she had lost her umbrella. 
    c) Laila said that when she got home she had found that she had lost her umbrella. 
    d) Laila said that when she had got home she found she lost her umbrella.    ⓑ 
Direct narration এ reported speech এ দুই বা তলতাক্তিক verb যক্তি past indefinite tense এ থালক তাহলে indirect 
narration এ কসই verb গুলোর past indefinite tense অপক্তরবক্ততথত থালক। 
 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                           Page | 4 
 
 
 
                                           NARRATION OF INTERROGATIVE SENTENCE 
 Interrogative Sentence এর কশলষ ক্তেজ্ঞাসা ক্তচহ্ন বা Question Mark থালক (?) 
 Ex: Itachi said to you, "What is your name". 
 Inverted comma উলে ক্তগলে = if, wh-question বসলব। 
Reporting V erb টি (ask/ asked /enquired to/ demand of/ want to know/ wonder) পক্তরবক্ততথত হে।      
21. He said to me, "Did you take the examination?" Make it indirect. (NU-11-12] 
      a) He asked me did I take the examination.   
      b) He asked to me if I took the examination. 
      c) He asked me if I had given the examination.   
      d) He asked me if I had taken the examination.         ⓓ 
22. He said to me, "Do you like music?" The indirect form of this sentence- 
      a) He said if I like music     b) He asked me do I like music 
      c)He asked to me if I like music    d) He asked me if liked music  ⓓ

      c) They enquired me who I was and what I wanted there now. 
      d) They enquired me who I was and what I wanted there then.      ⓓ

      a) The teacher said to me, "Why are you absent from class?" 
      b) The teacher said to me, "Why you have been absent from class."  
      c) The teacher said to me, "Why were you been absent from class." 
      d) The teacher said to me, "why were you absent from class?"      ⓓ 
26. Kalam said to you, "What is your name". Make it indirect.  
      a) Kalam asked you your name.    b) kalam asked you what your name was. 
      c) Kalam asked you what was your name.  d) What your name was kalam asked. ⓑ 
27. He said to me, "Which book do you want?" Make it indirect.  
      a) He said to me which book I wanted.   b) He asked to me which book I wanted. 
      c) He asked which book I wanted.   d) He said me which book I wanted.  ⓒ 
28. She told me, "What do you want?" Make it indirect  
      a) She told me what did he want.    b) She told me what he wanted. 
      c) She asked me what I wanted.    d) She asked me what you want.  ⓒ 
29. The indirect form of, "How dare you wake me up?" The lion roared at the mouse. 
      a) The lion roared and said to the mouse why he wakes him up.      
      b) The lion said to the mouse why is got him up. 
      c) The lion questioned the mouse about its waking up.              
      d) The lion roared and asked the mouse why it had waken him up.      ⓓ 
30. The indirect form of the sentence given below. He said to me, "Where have you been these days."  
      a) He asked me where I had been these days.   
      b) He enquired of me where I went these days. 
      c) He questioned where I had gone those days.  
      d) He wanted to know where I had went those days.       ⓐ 
31. Put the following sentence into indirect speech. "Why are getting wet in the rain?" 
      a) I told why he was getting wet in the rain.  b) I asked why he were getting wet in the rain. 
      c) I asked why he was getting wet in the rain.             
      d) I asked were why he getting wet in the rain.        ⓒ 

Farhan’s English Aid                                                                                                                                           Page | 5 
 
 
 
32. He said to me, “Where were you staying when you were in Dhaka”? The correct speech is:  
      a) He asked me where I was staying when I was in Dhaka 
      b) He asked me where I had been staying when I was in Dhaka  
      c) He asked me where I had been staying when I had been in Dhaka  
      d) He asked me where I stayed when I was in Dhaka       ⓑ 
Direct narration এ reported speech এ দুই বা তততাধিক verb যধি past indefinite tense এ থাতক তাহতে indirect 
narration এ সেই verb গুতোর past indefinite tense অপধরবধতিত থাতক। 
33. Change the speech: A man said to his father, What are you doing?

      c) A man asked what his father was doing   
      d) A man said to his father what you are doing        ⓐ

      a) She asked me that was I a student   b) She asked me if I was a student

      a) I asked Karim that he had passed    b) I asked Karim had he passed  
      c) I asked Karim if he had passed    d) I asked Karim if he passed   ⓒ 
36. "Are you a student? "She asked me is. Make it indirect  
      a) She asked me if I am a student.   b) She asked me if I was a student. 
      c) She asked me if was I a student.    d) She asked me was I a student.  ⓑ 
37. He inquired whether his name was not Ahmed. Make it direct.  
      a) He inquired. "Are you not Mr. Ahmed?"   
      b) He questioned, "Is not your name Ahmed." 
      c) He demanded. "Is not your name Ahmed?"   
      d) He said to me, "Is not your name Ahemed?"        ⓓ 
38. She asked me, "Are you happy in your new job?" Make it Indirect.  
      a) She asked me if I was happy in my new job.  b) She asked if have been happy in my new job. 
      c) She asked me whether I am happy in my new job.  
      d) She asked me if I had been happy in my new job.       ⓐ 
39. I said to him, "Will you follow me?" Make it indirect. 
      a) I asked him if he would follow me.   b) I asked him would he follow me. 
      c) I asked him if he would follow them.   d) I asked him if he would have follow me. ⓐ
